source.branch: After apply.c:use_grease() activates Glib on bare hands, the paid turn reaches allmain.c:moveloop_core -> glibr(). With no gloves, slipping rings, or offhand weapon, glibr() takes its primary weapon branch for the non-AKLYS, unwelded quarterstaff, prints the slip message, clears uwep, and drops it.
callers: C: allmain.c:moveloop_core calls do_wear.c:glibr() under if (Glib) after turn advancement and before nh_timeout(); wire the equivalent at that source-order boundary in js/allmain.js:finishElapsedTurn.
State setup: apply.c:doapply -> use_grease() -> potion.c:make_glib() activates hand Glib; the next paid turn reaches allmain.c:moveloop_core -> glibr().
dependencies: Preserve glibr branch order and shared equipment state: uarmg, uleft/uright, u.twoweap, uswapwep, uwep, welded(), bimanual(), canletgo(), Ring_off(), setuswapwep(), and setuwep() determine which items fall.

The active weapon arm uses do_wear.c naming and tense helpers, clears the wield slot, then calls do.c:dropx(); JavaScript equivalents are in js/wield.js, js/objnam.js, and js/do.js and must retain their state/drop contracts.
Keep glibr before nh_timeout in elapsed-turn planning and live execution. Its second message must reach the existing TTY path before later upkeep.
